notes:
## New features
- None in this release.

## Changes
- Map only now lives on the Contours tab, among the sheet preview tools, and is built for the sheet. The sheet shows just the basemap: the side panel, contours and objects are hidden, while the north arrow, scale bar and neatline stay as chosen, so you can export a clean map. Your composing panel stays open; click again to restore. It no longer appears on the Editor toolbar.
- Neatline co-ordinate numbers sit centred between the frame and the sheet edge, with clear space on both sides. The Slim margin is slightly wider to make room.

## Bug fixes
- Opening the Contours tab on a project saved by an earlier version (for example one with imported terrain) could show "The contour calculation could not be started or completed — The model has changed since this grid was calculated". It now shows the calculated cells with a short note to Update Grid, and never shows an error dialog for this.
- A stray letter could appear behind the Project / Inspector tabs after the side panel was hidden and shown again.
